title: Hover on an Effeck form crashes the language server
author: dev-ahn
body:
Hover over the provide or catch word in an Effeck file. The language server stops answering.

Expected: a hover describing the form, followed by the declaration documentation.

Reproduce with the service example in the welcome guide.

Observed panic: "did not expect KindClassDeclaration to have KindIdentifier in its trivia". The source change records a docs sweep with 0 of 198,891 hover requests failing after the fix.

comments.author: maya
comments.body: Reproduced on the service example. Accepted.

comments.author: smithers-agent
comments.body: Form words have source tokens without ordinary source nodes; desugared children can also lie out of order. The AST navigation fix finds an exact source token or the form’s declaration keyword. The source commit records a clean hover sweep.

comments.author: maya
comments.body: Landed #101 as 8fadacb5. Hovering provide and catch keeps the server alive.

title: Keep golden cases out of the converter prompt
author: cora
body: The prompt builder reads the cases used to score conversion. Use ten separate example pairs and reject normalized copies of held-out input or output, including copies inside larger blocks.

title: Show inferred types inside docs code blocks
author: dev-ahn
body: Readers should inspect Users.find and string!!Users in place. Add keyboard reachable compiler hovers and definitions without a client script.

title: Repack skipped platform optional dependencies
author: cora
body: A clean npm ci after scaffolding can install a lockfile without the platform compiler. Repack the tarball, check payloads and permissions, then install from the generated lockfile.

title: Resolve lambda and by-name forms through the forms table
author: maya
body: Use the syntax-only resolver for lambda, method, block parameter and by-name argument lowering. Report EK9100 when a form requires a choice. Keep the fork’s literal types and error unions.

title: Preserve Scope for a fork in a lambda expression body
author: dev-ahn
body: A block owns its forked fiber, but an expression body has no enclosing block. Compare both bodies in the declaration parity suite.

title: Do not deploy docs that fail on the released compiler
author: maya
body: Compile guide snippets with compiler and runtime release tarballs. The checkout compiler can accept syntax users cannot install.

title: Keep the landing page behind an explicit build flag
author: maya
body: Plain docs deployments must keep onboarding at the site root. Only EFFECK_LANDING=1 should build the draft landing page.

title: Pin the converter worker image by digest
author: maya
body: Record the image, compiler and dependency digests. A staged build is not evidence of a deployed service; document rollout and rollback.

title: Check using, interruption regions and finally exits in the mapper
author: dev-ahn
body: Project using through acquisition so the enclosing block removes Scope. Preserve try Exit values in finally (exit) and completion records through interruption regions.

title: Document Vite project references for .effeck sources
author: cora
body: A Vite root tsconfig often has files: [] and project references. Show effeck({ project: "tsconfig.app.json" }) and keep rewriteRelativeImportExtensions.

title: Scaffold with npm create effeck and exact package versions
author: cora
body: Verify npm create effeck@latest my-app. The compiler, runtime and Vite plugin must share the creator’s version. Effect stays pinned at 4.0.5.

title: Distinguish typed failures from defects in catch examples
author: dev-ahn
body: Ordinary catch handles expected failures. Show a typed fallback, a defect boundary and how to preserve interruption in a complete Cause.

title: Make hover notes precede declaration JSDoc
author: dev-ahn
body: Put the Effeck execution note first, then a rule, then the declaration JSDoc summary. Make the docs cache follow the language server split.

title: Reject pausing callbacks passed to synchronous JavaScript
author: cora
body: Array.map cannot run a callback that pauses. Report EK4301 at the callback and point at an Effect iteration.

title: Give hatch captures an input quick fix
author: dev-ahn
body: sync(() => text.length) captures an outside value. EK4405 should offer sync((text) => text.length, text), keeping the string type.

title: Track mapper parity separately from executable output
author: maya
body: Record identical declarations, union sites and known differences. Checking parity does not prove the executable rendering is implemented.

title: Publish Markdown copies beside the HTML guide
author: maya
body: Keep each guide available as Markdown with stable relative links and list pages in llms.txt. Replace private checkout paths before publishing.

title: Replace plain await with join and Deferred.await fixes
author: cora
body: Distinguish waiting for a fiber (join) from a Deferred (d.await()). An Effeck call already waits for its result.

title: Keep converter compile jobs credential free
author: maya
body: Compile only; never execute submitted code. Bound source size, diagnostics, CPU, memory and time. Logs omit submitted source and customer payloads.
